_comment: SAMPLE DATA — the win/loss & insight library. Codex appends entries from win/loss interviews, NPS verbatims, competitive news and research; humans can add via Contribute. type: win-loss | customer-quote | competitor-note | research. Newest first. Tags are free-form lowercase.

insights.summary: Mid-market win vs Competitor A: buyer cited 2-week onboarding vs their 8-week implementation as the deciding factor. Price was not a factor.
"WiSE is the first tool that made the e-invoicing mandate feel like an opportunity instead of a deadline." — Beta customer, approved for launch assets.
Lost a 40-seat deal: the customer's accountant recommended Competitor C. Product preferred ours; channel trust decided it. Third loss this quarter with the same pattern.
Competitor D doubled paid search spend on e-invoicing terms in France; their claims overstate current product capability — documented in the battlecard draft.
NPS verbatim analysis: reporting depth is the top detractor theme for the third consecutive quarter — now flagged to product as a launch-window risk.
"We were live before the trial ended." — Beta customer, cleared for use in tier-1 launch assets.
